outcome: Spontaneous preterm delivery in the second pregnancy
finding: Women with a prolonged second stage of labor (≥180 minutes) in their first term pregnancy had an increased risk of spontaneous preterm delivery in their second pregnancy.
mod_finding: The risk of spontaneous preterm delivery in the second pregnancy was increased in women with a prolonged (≥180 minutes) second stage in the first pregnancy, particularly among women who underwent a cesarean delivery in the first pregnancy.
